content: Bab-Dummad Abraham-wilubdaksad

Undar birgamar nasadgine, Bab-Dummad Abraham-wilub-dakesokalid, bule egi nue bensurdibeye. Bab-Dummad nugba Abrahamʼse gornonikid: —¡Abraham! Abraham Bab-Dummad-abin sogded: —Na, degite, an be-itomai.
Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga sogded: —Isaac, be-machi-wargwennagwad be nue-sabedi, Moriah-yalaganse be sede. A-yalagan-mosale, an bega yar-oyogoedgi be-machi be anga ogumakoed.

Oibosgu, wakudaryalaba Abraham gwisgusad, e-moli-uayasuid guakwaa nasiksad. Sapan amisbalid, machigwa-ogumakar-uklegoedgi ogaegar. Abraham bia Bab-Dummad ega-naoye-sogsadse nadegusad. E-machi-Isaac, degi, e-maimar-warbo eba nadmarmogad.
Abraham ibapaagus-nanaedgi yar egi dikasur-noe dakalid.
Geb degine, Abraham e-maimarga sogded: —Wegi bemar moli-uayasuidmala an-edarbemalo. Machigwa-anbogwa Bab-Dummad-e-nug-odummogega andi naoed. Geb degine, gannar anmar bese nonikoed.
Abraham ibmar-ogumaklegoed-ogaegala sapan susad, geb Isaac-e-gukingi mesisad. Abrahamʼdi es, degi, acha-gwallu-ogaar sesad. Geb degidgine, Abraham e-machi-ebo nade gusad.

Sikwas nanaedgine, Isaac Abrahamʼga sogded: —¡Baba! Abraham abin-sogded. —Degite machi, soge. Isaac sogded: —Anmar sapan, degi, acha-gwallu-ogaar sedanikid, degite, ¿bia sibad-wawaad-senigwad anmar Bab-Dummadga-ogumakar-ukoedde? Abraham Isaac-abin sogded:
—Machi, Bab-Dummad anmarga sibad-wawaad-senigwad udagoed, anmar ega ogumakar ukegar. Deyob, ebogwa imakenadap gusmalad.

Abraham, degi, e-machi-Isaac-ebo Bab-Dummad-ega-yar-sogsadse modapmargu, Abraham Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad. Geb a-aila-birgi sapan urbisad. Geb degine, e-machi-Isaac-edichagu, we-aila-birgi sapan-birgi Isaac-mesisad.
Abraham e-machi-oburgwegala es susgua,
Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur niba ese gollalid: —¡Abraham! ¡Abraham! Abraham Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur-abin sogded: —Degite. Wegi an gunai.

Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur Abrahamʼga sogded: —Melle machigwa be oakaloge. Melle be naibi-imake. Ar bato an wisid, be Bab-Dummad-dobee nanadiid. Ar be gwen sogsasulid, an-machi-wargwensakad melle be anga ukodeeye.
Abraham dakded, sibad-wawaad-machered sapi-imbaba e-bebegi galesnai. Abraham agi sunaded. Sibad-wawaad-machered-susgua, ogumakar e-machi-anar Bab-Dummadga uksad.
Geb a-sorbali, Abraham weyob we-neg onugsasad: Bab-Jehová ibmar-unnitiba-ukedye. A-ulale, amba we-garda narmaklenaidse sogleged: Bab-Jehová-yargine ibmar-unnitiba-uklegoedye.
Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur gannar irbogi niba Abrahamʼse gornonibalid,
ega sogded: —Bab-Jehová soged: ‘Ani, an bega ise-sogar soged: Ar be-machi-wargwensakad mer be anga ukodeeye be sogsasursoggu,

an bela-bela ise-nued begi binsaoed. Be-wagan bela-bela-mergu an imakoed, niisgwamar-niba-nanaidyob, degi, ukub-demar-gakagi-nikadyob an imakoed. Deginbali, be-wagan e-isdarmaladgi nakwedii guoed, degi, e-neggweburgan ei sudii guoed.
Deginbali, ar an bega-ibmar-sogsadyob be imaksasoggu, bela dula-we-napneggi-bukwamalad be-waganba an egi ise-nued binsamogoed.’
Abraham bia-e-maimar-obesa, ase gannar nonikid. Degine, bela Beerseba-neggweburse nade gusmalad. Agine, Abraham megidapid.
Nacor-e-wagan
Degi-undaradgine, Abrahamʼga soglenonikid, e-urba-Nacor machimala-nikamoye, Milca ega baksaye.
Deginbali, Nacor-e-masmala-baigan, Milcaʼbo-baksabalid, wemalad:
Deginbali, Nacor, Reúma-ebo baid-machimala nikusbalid. Reúmaʼde e-ome-dikarbalidid. We-ebogwa machimala-baksadi, wemalad:
